notes.content: [h3]Update Notes[/h3][p]Optimized Zhao Manli's restaurant scene.[/p][olist][*][p]Converted the original static CG to animated CG.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690560/fcb8fe2d8346bca2227f304ff41e9ec60795f4b5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added more expressions in this scene to fit the script: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690560/0af2854d751f36d9a7a13f77e3e6745bbc223dd0.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][p]Hope everyone likes it, thanks for playing![/p][p](In the next update, each female character's portraits will also have richer expressions.)[/p]
